title: Compute Reference Index — Public Payload (v0.1)
description: JSON Schema for the public, source-opaque compute reference price payload returned by GET /v1/price/{index_id} on app.flopsindex.com. Field names are snake_case, matching the live API exactly.

index_id.description: Canonical slug for the index (e.g. FLOPS-H100-OD, FLOPS-A100-SPOT, FLOPS-RTX6000Ada-OD). Mixed case occurs in vendor architecture names (Ada, Blackwell), so only the FIRST character is constrained to upper case.

value.description: Current published global value, rounded to 2 decimals, in the units declared by 'unit'.

as_of.description: Timestamp the value is published as-of (RFC 3339). On the anonymous surface this snaps to the ~6h grid (00/06/12/18 UTC).

delayed.description: Always true on the anonymous surface — the value is a delayed reference, not a real-time tick.

data_tier.description: Data tier on the public surface.

confidence.description: Confidence label on the published value (label only; no numeric weight).

change_24h.description: Banded 24h change direction, or null when no 24h comparison is available.

methodology_url.description: Public methodology page for this index.

verify_url.description: Public URL to verify a cited value against the index.

citation_url.description: Canonical citation URL — the permalink to surface alongside a quoted value.

permalink.description: Stable permalink to the index page.

upgrade.description: Pointer to keyed / customer access for higher-fidelity data.
